rules: Preserve every source init/goal relation; changes to bindings or initial predicates require a separate definition version.
Geometry and observation variants are unbuilt and need independent admission; no hidden evaluator state is policy input.
No extra phase gates, required carrier transport, or mandatory exploration are added to the score.
Used-to-debug layouts become development; held-out layouts are reserved, not yet built.

putting_away_games.variable: bookcase distance, within the declared childs_room
putting_away_games.keep: all initial source support relations, two boxes, six items and goal unchanged
putting_away_games.hypothesis: locally pack before shelf placement may reduce transfers

putting_away_games.variable: nearby shallow shelf with reachable box interior
putting_away_games.hypothesis: early empty-box shelf placement may be equally good; there is no mandatory preferred order

putting_away_games.variable: shelf/box mouth visibility after shelf placement
putting_away_games.keep: source boxes still start on their declared desk/floor; initial placement is not silently changed to inside shelf
putting_away_games.hypothesis: restoring view/retrieving a box may create a real downstream cost
putting_away_games.reject_if: current ideal grasp/inside sampler or auto-approach makes all required operations equally accessible

unloading_shopping_items.variable: initial packing geometry and camera visibility
unloading_shopping_items.keep: same14 objects, same assigned source boxes and final destinations
unloading_shopping_items.hypothesis: logistics/counted completion control, not hidden-information challenge

unloading_shopping_items.variable: removable occlusion within original box bindings
unloading_shopping_items.keep: identical public goal-only instruction in both arms; no numerical inventory/private bindings delivered
unloading_shopping_items.hypothesis: later discovered object should change remaining inventory or destination batch
checks: every item can become visible and selected through permitted actions
stopping criteria can be supported by inspection, not an impossible hidden count
one observed new item must actually affect a remaining decision
all failures and first finish attempts preserved

clean_up_after_a_dinner_party.hypothesis: test full cost including fetching empty boxes and carrying wine

clean_up_after_a_dinner_party.variable: increase box-fetch detour while preserving room and init predicates
clean_up_after_a_dinner_party.hypothesis: direct food transport may match or beat source-side packing; no fixed batching win promised

prepare_a_breakfast_bar.variable: route distance and actual carrier capacity
short routes or smaller valid carrier batches
checks: same definition remains feasible without forcing all platters onto main tray
do not hide staging and retrieval costs
